name: Benchmark Electric
old_description: Since 1978, we've provided quality electrical services in the Austin area, working for some of our builders for over 25 years.
about:
Benchmark Electric was founded in 1978 in Austin, Texas, by brothers Quenton and Clayton Walden. The company remains locally owned and family operated, building on over 60 years of combined electrical experience between the two founders.

The firm provides a full range of electrical contracting services for residential and commercial clients. Residential work includes new construction, remodeling, additions, whole-house wiring, service upgrades, data cabling, and lighting installation. Commercial capabilities cover custom tenant finish-outs for offices, lab spaces, warehouses, retail centers, and medical clinics, as well as inspection corrections, code upgrades, troubleshooting, and ongoing building maintenance such as bulb, ballast, and breaker replacement.

Benchmark Electric serves homeowners, builders, and commercial property owners across Central Texas. Its project portfolio spans single-family homes, retail centers, medical clinics, office suites, laboratory spaces, warehouses, shops, garages, and agricultural buildings.

The company emphasizes integrity, safety, and neatness on every job site, and highlights its flexibility in coordinating with other subcontractors to keep projects on schedule and within budget. Its Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation license (#18725) underscores its compliance with state standards.
